description: Find a tracked French store by part of its NAME or DOMAIN, across all sectors (case and accents ignored). Use it when the user names a store but you do not know its exact domain; then call consulter_marchand with the domain found. To discover stores by criteria rather than by name, use trouver_marchands. Returns: requete and marchands, every match (usually a few) with rang in its sector, ex_aequo, secteur, domaine, nom, note out of 100, nombre_avis, dernier_test, test_ancien and page. No match: an empty list, which means the store is not tracked yet.

langue.description: Language of the page links and, for consulter_marchand, of the summary sentence: fr (default) or en. Data fields are the same in both.

requete.description: At least two characters of the store name or domain, for example nocibe or sezane.

name: rechercher_marchand
title: Rechercher un marchand
